alt: Poster: Markets rebound after four-session fall - Nifty 50 22,753.20 up 0.68%, Sensex 73,606.75 up 0.66%, Smallcap +1.4%, midcap +1.2%, 26 Oct 2026
text:
Indian equities rebounded on 26 October after a four-session losing streak, with pharma leading and smallcaps outperforming.

• Sensex closed at 73,606.75, up 482.92 points (0.66%), and Nifty 50 at 22,753.20, up 153.20 points (0.68%), per HDFC Sky and Kotak Neo.
• Nifty Midcap 100 rose about 1.2% and Nifty Smallcap 100 about 1.4%, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky.
• Nifty Pharma gained about 1.8%, per Kotak Neo and HDFC Sky; FMCG, media and consumer durables ended lower, per HDFC Sky and ChiniMandi.
• The rupee closed at 95.19 against the dollar, weaker than the previous close, per HDFC Sky and ChiniMandi.

Our view: after a multi-day decline, a single-day bounce shows that selling pressure eased for a session, but one day of data says little about direction. Participants appear to be weighing elevated crude prices, geopolitical headlines and the upcoming US Federal Reserve decision. This is an interpretation of the data, not a prediction or advice.

For practitioners: after a four-day fall, do you read a broad bounce led by mid and smallcaps as a change in risk appetite, or as short-covering within a volatile range?
